### Which Side Are You On?
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-with-greg-laurie-nov-13-2006-1447333.html
Passage: Joshua 24:15
Points:
- Worldly movements that promise love and meaning ultimately leave people empty and disillusioned.
- Attempting to live half-heartedly with one foot in faith and one in the world is foolish and futile.
- Joshua's ancient challenge confronts every person with a clear and unavoidable choice.
- Believers cannot remain neutral; we must actively determine which side we stand on.
- Choosing to serve the Lord demands making real, serious changes in our daily lives.

### Will To Be Faithful
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/updated/will-to-be-faithful/
Passage: Joshua 24:15
Points:
- Serving God requires actively exercising our personal will rather than drifting into faith.
- When God presents new callings, recalling our initial encounter with Christ inspires fresh obedience.
- The decision of allegiance is a personal transaction directly between the individual soul and God.
- Declaring loyalty to Christ means holding oneself accountable as an internal witness before Him.
- Believers must focus on deciding to remain faithful while trusting that other believers will do likewise.

### Joshua’s Farewell
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/joshua-farewell
Passage: Joshua 24:15
Points:
- Joshua prepares Israel for his departure by reviewing God's past mercies and mighty acts of deliverance.
- Remembering God's rescue from sin and danger is essential for sustaining long-term covenant loyalty.
- God's great acts require a decisive response: wholehearted worship of the one true God over worthless idols.
- Because God is holy and jealous, He cannot be honored through half-hearted or divided devotion.
- Willful, unrepentant apostasy leaves no hope, whereas returning to Him in repentance brings mercy and pardon.
